description: The actual universal closure of a scoped formula is true exactly when its matrix is true at every tuple of values for the scoped slots.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_alls.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} {φ : L.BoundedFormula α n} {v : α → M} : φ.alls.Realize v ↔ ∀ (xs : Fin n → M), φ.Realize v xs
